faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, commonly known as IIT Kharagpur, for their project-based requirements under Platinum Jubilee Celebrations.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The post advertised in this recruitment notification is Marketing Lead, intended for candidates with extensive managerial and marketing experience.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Marketing Lead position under this specific recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBA or equivalent degree from a reputed institution along with the requisite professional experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required professional experience for the Marketing Lead post?
faq.answer: Applicants are required to have a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in marketing or a related professional field.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years, with possible relaxations as per sponsor agency rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a competitive monthly remuneration of up to Rs. 100000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. When is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for this recruitment drive is 08-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee for all categories?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for candidates applying for this position as the fee is NIL for all categories.

faq.question: Q10. How can eligible candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official application link provided in the important links section before the deadline.
